reply: [{"query":"如果研究者未能及时向申办者报告严重不良事件（SAE），FDA会对该研究者采取哪些处罚或资格取消（disqualification）措施？","query_en":"What penalties or disqualification actions does FDA take against an investigator who fails to timely report a serious adverse event (SAE) to the sponsor?","topic":"研究者未履行报告义务的处罚","absence_terms":["disqualification","penalty","warning letter","noncompliance"],"nearest_clause":null,"rationale":"文档详细规定了研究者向申办者报告SAE的时限与内容要求，但完全未涉及研究者未按要求报告时FDA可能采取的处罚、警告信或资格取消程序，这是该指南体裁常涉及但本文档未覆盖的合规后果问题。"},{"query":"研究者向申办者提交SAE报告时，应使用哪种标准表格（如MedWatch 3500A）或电子提交格式（electronic submission format）？","query_en":"What standard form (e.g., MedWatch Form 3500A) or electronic submission format should investigators use when reporting an SAE to the sponsor?","topic":"SAE报告标准表格与格式","absence_terms":["MedWatch","3500A","electronic submission format","reporting form"],"nearest_clause":{"page":10,"text":"The report should generally include information about the trial participant (such as sex, age, other demographic characteristics), a description (as detailed as possible) of the event (including any diagnostic testing results, interventions, outcomes), and the reporting source (if not the investigator)."},"rationale":"文档说明了研究者向申办者报告SAE应包含的信息内容，但从未指定研究者应使用的具体标准表格（如MedWatch 3500A）或电子提交格式，脚注中提及的电子提交指南仅针对申办者向FDA的报告，未覆盖研究者向申办者报告所用的表格格式。"}]
